newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Care in six new affiliations.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Care in six new affiliations.

text.p: Specialty Care Network Inc, a physician practice management company, said Monday it has affiliated with three more group practices and signed definitive agreements with three other groups.
The six new practices had combined revenues of $19 million in 1996, it said.
Terms of the transactions were not disclosed.

The company said that upon completion of the pending transactions, it will be affiliated with 105 physicians in 15 practices located in seven states and manage five facilities owned by the affiliated groups.
